title: mandevilla velame
intro: Mandevilla velame, commonly known as the white mandevilla, is a type of flowering vine native to South America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, relieving stress, and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Mandevilla velame are attributed to its ability to interact with the body's GABA receptors, producing a calming effect, as well as its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Mandevilla velame include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
